item.text:
No tools needed here, just evaluating the examples directly. ASP-01 looks fine with the progressive form as is. For ASP-02, "쓰는 중이다" wrongly implies the act of putting glasses on, when the context describes an ongoing state of wearing them—so it needs revision, maybe to something clearer like "쓴 상태다" to avoid the ambiguity of "쓰고 있다."

ASP-03 is fine as is. CAU-01 correctly preserves the causative structure where Sena's instruction led Eden to cut the ribbon, so that stays. CAU-02 also checks out.

PAS-01 has the subject and object roles reversed from the source, so it needs correction to match who did the pushing versus who was pushed.
